task.title: Setting Up the Network
task.shortdesc: Connect and configure the network components to provide wired and wireless network access.

prereq.p: Before you set up the network, make sure that you have:

ul.li: An active Internet service from an Internet Service Provider (ISP).
The network information supplied by the ISP.

prereq.note: Do not connect or disconnect network cables during an electrical storm.

context.p: This task explains how to connect the , connect the , configure Wi-Fi, connect client devices, and verify the network connection.
context.note: Complete the steps in the specified sequence.
If the ISP device includes a router, configure the ISP device as required to prevent conflicting routing functions. Contact the ISP if you do not know which operating mode to use.
